product_metadata.title: Marvelous Molds Grand Tassel Drop Silicone Mold | Cake Decorating with Fondant Gum Paste Icing
features: Creates easy-to-apply, realistic tassel cake decorations perfect with swags around the top of a decorated cake. Designed for professional cake decorators, hobbyists and novices alike.
Flexible, food grade silicone makes these molds easy to use when transferring fondant, gum paste and modeling chocolate decorations to your cake. Complete instructions provided.
Patented, self trimming mold design produces tassel drops that can be applied to a fondant covered or buttercream iced cake.

Made in the U.S.A. with food grade, high quality silicone. Ideal for use with edible materials like: chocolate, sugarpaste, butter, ganash, flower paste, candy, Isomalt, modeling paste, marzipan. Unsurpassed for non-edible materials too: clays, wax, plaster, resins, soap, epoxy & more.
Measures 0.46 x 2.46 inches, BPA Free, Dishwasher Safe, Freezer Safe, Color: Clear Green.
description: The Grand Tassel Drop is a exquisite tassel silicone mold designed to create a double stranded tassel decoration on the side of a cake. The Grand Tassel Drop Mold can also be used to create a tassel on a graduation cap and is perfect for decorating cupcakes and cookies. Place it between any swag cake decoration to add a finished, artful result that will turn heads and be noticed. This mold creates a very classy decoration that can be used for any occasion and with a multitude of edible mediums.
